# The double-read agreement, pooled — generated by `scripts/double_read_agreement.py`

*2 batch(es), 56 independently double-read keys.  Pooled raw agreement **53.6%**, pooled Cohen's kappa **+0.35**.  Between-batch variance (DerSimonian–Laird) tau² = 0.0930; the size at which one more ~23-key batch moves the pooled share by more than 5 points with under 5% probability is **n\* = 268** keys (PREDICTION.md's rule, recomputed from the batches so far) — NOT YET: 212 keys to go.*
